hooks.command: input=$(cat); sid=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id'); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command'); d=/tmp/claude-quality-clean; mkdir -p "$d"; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|])[[:space:]]*just[[:space:]]+(quality|check)([[:space:]]|$)'; then touch "$d/$sid.clippy" "$d/$sid.lizard"; fi; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|])[[:space:]]*just[[:space:]]+clippy([[:space:]]|$)'; then touch "$d/$sid.clippy"; fi; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|])[[:space:]]*just[[:space:]]+lizard([[:space:]]|$)'; then touch "$d/$sid.lizard"; fi

input=$(cat); sid=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id'); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'cargo([[:space:]]+\+[^[:space:]]+)?[[:space:]]+clippy' && printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE -- '-D[= ]warnings|--deny[= ]warnings'; then mkdir -p /tmp/claude-quality-clean && touch "/tmp/claude-quality-clean/$sid.clippy"; fi

input=$(cat); sid=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id'); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q -- '-m lizard' && printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q -- '-l rust' && printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q 'crates'; then mkdir -p /tmp/claude-quality-clean && touch "/tmp/claude-quality-clean/$sid.lizard"; fi

input=$(cat); sid=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id'); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '\bgit\b.*\bcommit\b'; then rm -f "/tmp/claude-quality-clean/$sid.clippy" "/tmp/claude-quality-clean/$sid.lizard"; fi

input=$(cat); sid=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id'); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if ! printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '\bgit\b.*\bcommit\b'; then echo '{}'; exit 0; fi; missing=''; [ -f "/tmp/claude-quality-clean/$sid.clippy" ] || missing="clippy"; [ -f "/tmp/claude-quality-clean/$sid.lizard" ] || missing="$missing lizard"; if [ -z "$missing" ]; then echo '{}'; else echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"ask\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Run 'just quality' (clippy + lizard) and fix the underlying issue behind anything it flags before committing - missing:$missing. Codacy cannot analyze Rust in this flatpak environment, so these are the real local gates; do not restructure code just to dodge a specific rule's counting behavior, see CLAUDE.md.\"}}"; fi
